controllerActions: suss: RubyDiscoveryPattern variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-ruby
railsUnderscore: suss: constant-to-path convention name, defined in @suss/adapter-ruby; selects Rails' (Zeitwerk's) underscore rule
rails: suss: this pack's own name, used as RubyPack.name and as boundaryBinding recognition
ApplicationController: Rails: the base class every generated controller extends
app: Rails: the default directory a project's own code lives under
Controller: Rails: the suffix every generated controller class name carries
render: Rails: the controller method that writes a response body, and its status under the status: keyword
head: Rails: the controller method that writes a response with a status and no body, the status given first
status: Rails: the keyword render and head both take the response status under
params: Rails: ActionController::Metal#params, the request parameters every controller reads
request: Rails: ActionController::Metal#request, the inbound request object
response: Rails: ActionController::Metal#response, the outbound response object
session: Rails: ActionController::Metal#session, delegated to the request
logger: Rails: AbstractController::Logger#logger, a config accessor on every controller
action_name: Rails: AbstractController::Base#action_name, the action currently running
before_action: Rails: AbstractController::Callbacks::ClassMethods#before_action, which runs a controller method before the action
skip_before_action: Rails: AbstractController::Callbacks::ClassMethods#skip_before_action, which takes a before_action back off
rescue_from: Rails: ActiveSupport::Rescuable::ClassMethods#rescue_from, which names the method that runs when the action raised
only: Rails: the keyword before_action and skip_before_action take the actions they cover under
except: Rails: the keyword before_action takes the actions it leaves out under
withKeyword: suss: RbControllerFilter method source, defined in @suss/adapter-ruby; the filter names its method under the with: keyword
argument: suss: RbControllerFilter method source, defined in @suss/adapter-ruby; the filter names its method as a leading symbol
collection: Rails routing DSL: on: value routing a bare verb call to a resource's own path, with no :id
member: Rails routing DSL: on: value routing a bare verb call to one resource's :id
arguments: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a call's own argument list
pair: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for a key: value or key => value argument
key: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a pair node's key
value: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a pair node's value
block: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a call's do...end block
body: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a block's own body
receiver: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a call's receiver expression
method: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a call's method name
parameters: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a block's |x, y| parameter list
string_array: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for a %w[] word list
symbol_array: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for a %i[] symbol list
bare_symbol: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for one element of a %i[] list
each: Ruby core: Array#each, looping a routes block once per element
each_with_index: Ruby core: Array#each_with_index, looping a routes block once per element with its position
all: Rails routing DSL: the via: value on match that routes every HTTP method
mount: Rails routing DSL: ActionDispatch::Routing::Mapper::Base#mount, serving an engine's route set under a path
routes: Rails: Rails::Engine#routes, the route set an app or engine draws into
isolate_namespace: Rails: Rails::Engine.isolate_namespace, which puts every controller the engine routes under the given module
lib: Rails: the directory under an engine's root its Engine class is defined in, which Rails takes the root from
config: Rails: the directory under an engine's root its routes.rb is in
class: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for a class definition
module: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for a module definition
name: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a class or module definition's constant
superclass: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for the class a class definition extends
constant: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for a bare constant
scope_resolution: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for a Name::Nested constant path
